text:
Keisha: Noticed an odd uptick in 'Needs Outreach' for small accounts after yesterday's playbook sampling change. +5% in the morning digest.
Omar: same. Looks like some accounts got scored twice and flagged twice.
Ruth: digging in 1:02 UTC 1 - could be the sampling job emitting duplicate payloads to the scoring service.
eng-oncall: :information_source: job-runner: sampler v0.9.8 executed 2026-06-12T20:55:12Z (task id sam-4521)
Keisha: SQL to surface duplicates (quick):
```
SELECT account_id, count(*) as score_events
FROM scoring.events
WHERE change_ts BETWEEN '2026-06-12 20:50' AND '2026-06-12 21:10'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
LIMIT 200;
```
Omar: results: ~220 accounts with 2 events, mostly low-touch. payload ids different but sample_seq identical.
Ruth: sample_seq collision suggests the sampler restarted mid-run and retried some batches without checkpointing. code change in v0.9.8 added parallel workers but missed durable cursor.
Keisha: short-term: pause sampler runs for the cohorts impacted and dedupe incoming scoring events by (account_id, sample_seq).
eng-oncall: :information_source: Pausing sampler for cohort=small by Omar at 21:12 UTC.
Omar: I'll patch scoring ingestion to ignore duplicates where sample_seq matches within 1h window, deploy a quick fix, and then replay a corrected stream for affected accounts.
Ruth: follow-up: add an idempotency token to sampling payloads (sha256 of batch_id+worker_id) and persist last_processed_batch per worker to avoid replays.
Keisha: also add an alert: >1% of cohort having duplicate score_events in 30m triggers a pause and pager.
cs-bot: :white_check_mark: Hotfix task created: CS-2345 (owner: Omar). Keisha: thanks team. will monitor replays and freeze outreach until reconciled. :thumbsup:
